rules.statement: The defendant committed deceit and malpractice as per Section 42 of the Judicature Act.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The charges against the 1st respondent had not been made out to the satisfaction of the Court. But, the 2nd respondent is guilty of deceit and malpractice under section 42 of the Judicature Act. (2) If the conduct of the attorney-at-law is also criminal in character, as in this case, the Attorney-at-law will be disenrolled even though there is no conviction

rules.statement: An attorney-at-law whose conduct is criminal may be disenrolled even in absence of a conviction.
